name: poselib
description: Minimal solvers for calibrated camera pose estimation. Pinned to cdcseacave/PoseLib commit 26d397d5ad487959b0c4243d61ef6f75715eb040 from feature/spherical-camera-support (upstream PoseLib master up to #215), with unified bearing-vector estimate_* API for pinhole and spherical (equirectangular) cameras; opt.max_error is angular (radians) for the bearing estimators.
